items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: He hired me to play. ... That was Joe Robichaud's dad. ... He wanted a banjo player. He had a banjo player. He could hire me, and he hired me.

ctx.x: Did he have a band or just two people? He hired me to play.

He had a big band. He had a big band. Yeah, a big band. He introduced me as a banjo player off the coast of California. And then I played at the Crescent and the Tulane Table. That was Joe Robichaud's dad. Just large, been a long time. Pico was the one that told us about him. He wanted a banjo player. He had a banjo player. He could hire me, and he hired me. Four men in a row of shoes.

Did you know Alfred Wilson played piano? Alfred Wilson? Man can't? I don't think so. I think he mostly had women. You know Paul Louie's? He's a piano player and a singer. Yeah, you're talking about the one that's alive today. He's a great big fella. He looks like a big Filipino. No, I don't know him. I'm thinking of somebody else. Paul Louie is his name. I'm thinking a little short guy. I'm thinking of a little short guy. I'm thinking of a French guy. Moulier. Moulier. Claremment player? No, Frank is a piano…
